description: Waits for the blitter, programs its control registers once, then fills a small grid of table entries. Each entry receives the next running word value, and a blit is started for each cell from the global area.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:1FE1C
name: setup_blitter_copy_loop
description: Waits for the blitter, sets its mask, control and modulo registers, then loops over a range of words. It points the blitter at each source word and starts a copy into the destination.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:1FEDC
name: dispatch_asset_group_setup
description: Calls three routines with the same arguments, then when a global flag is set, calls five more. The routine references the names of nine .ALL resource groups, including BOSSSTUFF.ALL, COIN.ALL and EXPLOSION.ALL.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2003E
name: run_command_table_entries
description: Clears two globals and sets a table-state word, then walks a null-terminated list of entries. Each entry must be an even index from 4 to 18, otherwise it is replaced with 0, and the matching routine from a jump table is called.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20138
name: spawn_octopus_actor
description: Toggles a global counter and, on every second call, allocates a slot from a global table and calls several routines. It sets record fields to 1, 0 and 6 and, when an argument flag is set, sets a field to 1 and another to 80; the routine references OCTOPUS.ALL and OCTOPUSBULLET.ALL.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2025A
name: advance_until_routine_flags
description: Calls a routine and advances a coordinate in steps of 16 while it is below 209. The loop stops when the returned word has its top bit set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20294
name: stub_return_passthrough
description: Returns immediately with the value it was given, without any other work. It is reached only through a handler table.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2029C
name: initialize_entity_list
description: Assigns a counter value to a global slot on first use, then loops sixteen times. Each pass takes the next record from a free pointer list, marks its first word as minus one, sets another word to 1 and copies a global long into a field.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20490
name: initialize_object_slot_fields
description: Advances a global counter and replaces a global pointer with the value in A3 around three routine calls. It then sets the record's first word to minus one, clears one field and sets another to minus one.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2050E
name: spawn_pfish_actor
description: Toggles a global counter and, on every second call, takes a slot from a global table and calls several routines. It sets record fields to 1, 0 and 6 and calls two more routines; the routine references the text PFISH.ALL.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20736
name: set_object_state_fields
description: Advances a global counter and replaces a global pointer with the value in A3 after calling one routine. It then calls another routine, sets three record fields to 1, 0 and 6, and calls a final routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2079A
name: append_spawn_entry_set_fields
description: When a toggle flag is set and an argument is non-zero, reads a word from a pointer and calls a routine. If that returns zero, it appends a 10-byte entry to a global table of at most 90 entries, then sets record fields to 1, 0, minus one, two positions and 200.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:207E8
name: append_spawn_entry_set_fields
description: Reads a word from a pointer and calls a routine. If that returns zero, it appends a 10-byte entry to a global table of at most 90 entries, then sets record fields to 1, 0, minus one, two positions and 200.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20842
name: append_spawn_entry_direct
description: Appends a 10-byte entry to a global table without checking any routine result, then sets record fields to 1, 0, minus one, two positions and 200. The table count is incremented and the routine spins forever past 90 entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:208BA
name: append_position_entry_set_fields
description: Appends a 10-byte table entry built from two incoming word arguments with a position offset of 16, then calls routines and sets record fields to 1, 0 and minus one, copies two global positions into fields, sets a field to 200 and sets a flag word to 1.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2092A
name: initialize_entity_properties
description: Advances a global counter and replaces a global pointer with the value in A3 around two routine calls. It then sets a state word to 1 and a field to 0, sets another to minus one, copies two global values into position fields, sets a field to 200 and sets a flag word to 1.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20982
name: stub_no_operation
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is reached only through a pointer table, so it acts as an empty handler.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20988
name: search_spawn_table_for_value
description: Returns minus one if a value built from an argument and a sign flag matches an entry of a global table, and zero otherwise. The table is scanned backwards from its last entry in steps of 14 bytes.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:209C0
name: return_minus_one
description: Returns the value minus one in the result register, without other work.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:209CA
name: spawn_bigfishy_actor
description: Toggles a global counter and, on every second call, takes a slot from a global table and calls several routines. It sets record fields to 1, 0 and 6 and calls one more routine; the routine references the text BIGFISHY.ALL.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20B1A
name: call_and_return_pair
description: Calls one routine and returns the values held in the two result registers as a 64-bit result.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20B34
name: initialize_expseu_pointer
description: Calls two routines, then assigns the next counter value to a global slot if it is still zero and advances the counter by four. The routine references the text EXPSEU.ALL and EXPSEU_BUB.ALL.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20BA2
name: wait_pair_then_set_constants
description: Calls a routine in a loop while either of two words at the pointer is non-zero. Once both are zero it writes the constants 532 and 534 into them and calls one routine; the routine references the text SUBTOKEN.RAW.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20BE6
name: wait_pair_then_set_constants
description: Calls a routine in a loop while either of two words at the pointer is non-zero. Once both are zero it writes the constants 532 and 534 into them and calls one routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20BEC
name: decode_tile_map_data
description: Decodes a run-length encoded tile map. The first byte gives a row count, then each entry writes a tile index and computed position words, followed by repeat bytes; decoding stops at the terminator 254, and a zero first byte writes nothing.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20C56
name: clear_byte_globals
description: Sets seven adjacent byte-sized global variables to zero.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20C82
name: scan_slots_and_reset_counters
description: Walks three 28-byte slots of a global area. For each slot whose word at offset 18 is positive, it scans a table of bytes against a threshold of 27 and, when the scan succeeds, zeroes that counter and calls a routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20CBC
name: scan_cells_for_flag_bit
description: Scans a global array of 16-bit cells for one whose looked-up value has a particular flag bit set, stopping at a fixed lower bound. On a match it calls one routine unless a global flag is set.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20D2C
name: handle_input_state_machine
description: Reads an input status value and applies a signed step to a coordinate of the record, choosing a direction code by comparing signs. It then scans a status table for a fixed value and calls the matching handler through the function table, or waits for a status bit when the lookup fails.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:20ECC
name: scan_actor_records_for_contact
description: Scans a table of cell values and, depending on a mode flag, either checks actor state values and position bounds or walks a list of records. Matching records trigger routines and table-selected handlers; the pseudo-code is truncated partway, so the later logic is not described.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21266
name: call_routine_only
description: Calls one routine and returns. It performs no other work.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2135A
name: trigger_cell_in_range
description: Scans a cell list for a byte between 4 and 6. When one is found and a global flag is clear, it calls two routines, applies a signed step to a position word, sets a direction code and a flag to 50, then calls two more routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2142E
name: check_pointer_bounds_and_state
description: When a flag is set and a position value is non-negative, checks the byte at a pointer against 27 and loops calling a routine. For a record in state 1 that lies inside a horizontal window it adjusts a global position, sets a flag and calls one routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:214BE
name: clear_record_when_in_region
description: Walks a list of entries from a global pointer and checks a byte threshold. A record in state 8 inside a region has eight bytes cleared from offset 4 and triggers routines, while a record in state 1 has its position bounds checked.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21814
name: check_collision_bounds
description: Calls one routine when a flag word is zero or a table entry lacks a bit, and the record's horizontal and vertical positions fall within a window around the input record.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:218D0
name: search_table_for_short_match
description: Scans a global table of pointers until it finds a null entry or an entry whose word at offset 94 equals the 16-bit input. It then returns that pointer together with the input value.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:218F0
name: stub_no_operation
description: Returns immediately without any work. It is reached only through a pointer table, so it acts as an empty handler.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21924
name: update_lfsr_random_state
description: Advances a global 32-bit shift-register state once for each bit of the input count, applying a feedback constant when a bit shifts out. It returns the low word of the state when the input is zero, otherwise the high word of its product with the input.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2195C
name: reset_table_write_pointer
description: Sets a global write pointer to the start of the global table, so later stores begin at the first entry.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:2196A
name: store_context_to_table
description: Writes six values into the next six slots of a global table: the A0 word, four input registers, and a code address formed from a routine base and A1. It then advances the table pointer by six entries.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21998
name: search_global_table_entry
description: Walks a global table of six-word entries until it reaches an entry whose first long equals the input value in D0, or a null entry. The pointer is left at that position.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:219B2
name: mark_record_and_dispatch_status
description: If the word at offset 96 of the record reached through the input structure is zero, it sets that word to minus one and dispatches the handler when a status table matches the value 1. It then calls one routine with both pointers.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21A02
name: scan_status_table_value_1
description: Scans a four-entry status table for the value 1 and calls the handler on a valid match. Otherwise it waits for a status bit to toggle.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21A12
name: dispatch_handler_then_call_routine
description: Calls the handler in the structure when the index in D1 is between 0 and 3, otherwise waits for a status bit to toggle. Then it calls one routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21A18
name: wait_status_bit_then_call
description: Writes a fixed control value to a global location, busy-waits until a status bit clears and sets again, then calls one routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21A4A
name: dispatch_handler_mismatch_call
description: Calls the handler in the structure when the byte at offset 34 differs from the low byte of D0 or a per-index global flag is set, then calls one routine.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21A88
name: step_record_into_free_neighbour
description: Moves the record by sixteen units in a direction chosen from a sign input, checking a neighbouring entry in a global table. If that neighbour is free, it sets the position, marks the record with minus one, links it back to the caller, copies a word into a global and calls two routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21AA2
name: step_record_when_neighbour_free
description: If a global table entry behind the current pointer is negative, sets the record's position sixteen units back and marks the record with minus one. It then links the record back to the caller, copies a word into a global and calls two routines.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21B70
name: send_exec_io_request
description: Stores two input registers into global variables and points an I/O request block at the global area with command code 37. It then starts the request through the Exec library's SendIO call, using a pointer kept in a global.

key: bubble and squeak (1994)(audiogenic)[cr pdx](disk 1 of 2)/Bubble and Squeak (1994)(Audiogenic)[cr PDX](Disk 1 of 2).adf:code:0:21BA0
name: abort_and_wait_io_request
description: Calls two Exec library functions through pointers held in a global base: AbortIO first, then WaitIO. It cancels an outstanding I/O request and waits for it to finish.
